answer: Agents prove uniqueness by locking stake in a per-identity vault whose unlock key is derived from a challenge-response sequence issued only to agents maintaining a sub-50ms link to a rotating set of physical jetty-hosted oracles. The attacker's fable that virtual machines are free collapses because each additional head requires either a dedicated low-latency physical uplink (scarce and costly) or accepts rising slash risk as the vault detects correlated latency signatures and burns the locked funds.
